payload.title: [Fig. 5] Ensemble resampling
payload.description: This notebook explores ensemble resampling techniques for the Last Millennium Reanalysis, generated using an Ensemble Kalman Filter. It demonstrates the challenges of maintaining both the posterior distribution and temporal structure of climate variability. The notebook applies various resampling strategies, including autoregressive models, fractional Gaussian noise, and power-law scaling, to the offline data assimilation ensemble. The results are visualized and compared to highlight the importance of choosing appropriate resampling methods.
